meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: 网页与数字界面设计师在构建Web页面或应用组件时，若受够了千篇一律的AI味设计，请用此技能。一键生成极具视觉冲击力、排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码，告别平庸，打造令人难忘的高品质数字界面。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果受够了千篇一律的AI味网页设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate production-grade frontend code with unique typography and stunning motion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of generic AI-look web designs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在你构建网页或应用组件时，会先定一个大胆的美学方向（极简、繁复、复古未来等），再写出可运行的生产级前端代码，排版、配色、动效都按这个方向做。
howto.when: 当你要构建网页、组件或界面，并想避开千篇一律的 AI 味设计时，它会接管。原文未写固定触发词。

say.text: 帮我做一个作品集首页，走粗野主义风格，别用 Inter 字体
say.note: 它会先定风格方向，再写代码

say.text: 给这个 React 组件加一个滚动触发的入场动效
say.note: 会用 CSS 或 Motion 库实现

say.text: 重新设计这个落地页，换成深色主题，排版更大胆

howto.what_en: Claude picks a bold aesthetic direction (minimal, maximalist, retro-futuristic, etc.) before writing runnable, production-grade frontend code for your page or component, with typography, color and motion matching it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build a web page, component or interface and want to avoid generic AI-looking design. No fixed trigger words are given; it is invoked as a design step before coding.

say_en.text: Build a portfolio homepage in a brutalist style, no Inter font.
say_en.note: It sets a direction, then writes the code.

say_en.text: Add a scroll-triggered entrance animation to this React component.
say_en.note: Uses CSS or the Motion library.

say_en.text: Redesign this landing page: dark theme, bolder typography.
